gaps.lead: She'll be on a flight, so she can't join the call.
gaps.sentence: She'll be on a flight, so ___ join the call.
gaps.explanation: won't be able to = future inability.

gaps.lead: The flat was too cramped for their three children.
gaps.sentence: The flat wasn't ___ their three children.
gaps.explanation: too cramped for = not spacious enough for.

gaps.lead: They say the new tunnel will halve journey times.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ by the new tunnel.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: reported statement, passive meaning.

gaps.lead: My grandfather had completely forgotten that he phoned me last night.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather didn't ___ phoning me last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Completely forgotten' becomes 'didn't have any recollection of'.

gaps.lead: Brian was really interested in North American history in his school days.
gaps.sentence: Brian ___ North American history in his school days.
gaps.hint: be interested in = have an ___ in
gaps.explanation: 'To be interested in' becomes the noun pattern: 'had an interest in'.

gaps.lead: They won't let you in without a ticket.
gaps.explanation: let somebody do → be allowed to do: won't be allowed in.
